elaine_docs: Quick heads-up — opening a tiny docs PR to replace the old streaming example with the new resume-cursor flow. Will add py/ts/go compact snippets & a short migration note.

sam_sdk: :thumbsup: Thanks! Can you call out retry semantics? The runtime now expects idempotent resume tokens, callers should re-send last acked cursor.

elaine_docs: Yep. Plan: include a note + code showing how to catch a transient 502/timeout and call resume(cursor) instead of restarting.

nisha_devex: Suggest we make examples minimal — show the streaming loop and a tiny helper `resume_on_error()` that handles backoff/jitter. Also add links to batching knobs page.

matt_pm: Heads-up: customers ask for reduced token echo; add how to use `prefix_cache=True` or prefix trimming in the example.

elaine_docs: Nice call. Drafting snippets now. Quick preview for Python:
```python
# resume-friendly streaming
cursor = None
try:
    for chunk in client.stream("gpt-mini", prompt):
        process(chunk)
        cursor = chunk.cursor
except RetryableError:
    client.stream.resume("gpt-mini", cursor)
```

sam_sdk: Minor nit: use `stream.resume(...)` API name — we standardized on `stream_resume` only in the runtime but SDK exposes `stream.resume()` across languages. Keep examples consistent across py/ts/go.

elaine_docs: Good catch — will update.

nisha_devex: For TS example, keep async iterator pattern. Quick sample:
```ts
let cursor: string | null = null
try {
  for await (const patch of client.stream.resume("gpt-mini", { prompt })) {
    handle(patch)
    cursor = patch.cursor
  }
} catch (e) {
  await client.stream.resume("gpt-mini", cursor)
}
```

sam_sdk: Also add small note about idempotency keys for retries when doing partial outputs (link to docs/batching#idempotency). Add a cross-link to SDK changelog v0.18.

elaine_docs: Will include link fixes + changelog ref. CI bot: `docs-lint` ran — found a broken anchor in guide/streaming.md line 84.

elaine_docs: Fix pushed: 5529876543-1 — PTAL @sam @nisha, I trimmed the caching example and added a one-paragraph migration note.

sam_sdk: Reviewed, just one comment about verbatim `cursor` field naming (it should be `resume_cursor` in Go SDK). If easy to normalize, do it; otherwise add a language note.

elaine_docs: I'll add a small table row calling out the field name differences per SDK.

nisha_devex: After merge, can we add a short "How we measured regressions" snippet? A tiny eval harness that replays prompt sets and asserts latency and token delta.

matt_pm: Yes please — that'll help PMs and CS.

elaine_docs: Cool. I'll merge after addressing SDK name note and CI green. Thanks all :tada:
